name: gpt-image
description: Generate and edit project images with OpenAI GPT Image models through a bundled local MCP server.

openai_api_key.title: OpenAI API key
openai_api_key.description: API key used only by the local GPT Image MCP server. Stored in Claude's sensitive plugin configuration.

openai_base_url.title: OpenAI Base URL
openai_base_url.description: OpenAI or trusted OpenAI-compatible endpoint base URL. The chosen endpoint receives the API key, image prompt, and edit input images. Default: https://api.openai.com/v1
